content.text: Welcome to my personal site, a living demonstration of the technical breadth and strategic leadership I bring to an organization. While my professional foundation is rooted in robust backend development, this platform is engineered to showcase proficiency across the modern software development lifecycle—from advanced UI architecture to resilient, cloud-based DevOps.

I invite recruiters, hiring managers, and potential collaborators to explore this site as a comprehensive view of my ability to lead and execute complex technical visions, perfectly aligning with the demands of a Director of Engineering role.
Explore the dynamic sections to gain a complete understanding of my expertise:
My professional background, experience, and contact information.
Blog content covering advanced System Design, Engineering Management strategies, and best practices.
Content focused on key Data Structures and Algorithms.
In-depth details of my past projects and a transparent look at the projects I am currently working on.
A collection of photos that showcase my work and interests.
And More! I welcome you to navigate the VS Code-themed interface and evaluate the technical acumen, architectural mindset, and hands-on execution skills demonstrated throughout the site.

The site is not just a digital resume; it is a functioning technical project designed to showcase my command over critical technologies. To go beyond a standard portfolio, I integrated several sophisticated features using engineering design and prompt-based development with Google Gemini and Claude, illustrating a capacity for deep technical innovation and adoption of AI tools.
The initial aesthetic foundation of the VS Code design was inspired by the linked tutorial available on youtube, with all advanced features and current architecture developed independently.
Developed using React and Vite, the site features a highly customized, intuitive interface.
The entire platform is deployed on AWS and fully managed using Terraform (Infrastructure as Code), demonstrating expertise in scalable, maintainable, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure.

The underlying visual framework is modeled after Visual Studio Code (VS Code). This deliberate choice reflects my deep engagement with developer tools and serves as a proof-of-concept for a future SaaS product requiring an IDE-like user experience.
A custom interface allowing for efficient, parallel navigation of various content sections.
Integration of Monaco Editor and Pyodide to provide a functional, client-side code editing and execution environment for Data Structures and Algorithms content.
Implementation of a robust engine that connects the Explorer menu actions to dynamic content rendering within the tabbed interface.
Includes a detailed chronology view for experience.

about.name: Aashish Shenoy
about.title: Engineering Leader
about.summary: Strategic Engineering Leader, adept at scaling global Finance and SaaS organizations. Expert in cloud data architecture, governance, and risk. Leverages empathetic, customer-focused leadership and technical craft to drive operational excellence and measurable business impact.

experience.company: Salesforce • Feb 2025 - Present • New York, New York
details: Strategic Transition & Resilience: Successfully led the acquired product engineering team through corporate harmonization, maintaining high team morale and engagement through a high-ambiguity transition period.

Operational Excellence & Security: Spearheaded the design and launch of a centralized Admin Console, eliminating direct Hands-In-Production access for customer configurations, reducing operational risk and overhead across the entire acquired product suite.

Infrastructure Modernization: Drove critical infrastructure migrations, transitioning complex single-machine workloads to Kubernetes clusters to eliminate Single Points of Failure (SPOF) and ensure system reliability and scale under new corporate standards.

Hands-On Innovation: Led technical innovation efforts, including the hands-on prototyping of a dynamic data extraction load management strategy designed to improve ServiceNow backup throughput by 3x, demonstrating sustained engineering agility.

Corporate Integration & Future Readiness: Championed the rapid adoption of Salesforce's development methodologies and the Service Ownership model. Steered Al and Agentic upskill (Cursor, Gemini, Agents, MCP) to future-proof the team and align with target platforms.

experience.company: Own Data Company (Acquired by Salesforce) • Apr 2024 - Jan 2025 • Englewood Cliffs, New Jersey
details: Product Leadership & P&L Impact: Directed the engineering function for the Recover for ServiceNow product. Oversaw a 100%+ increase in ARR (from $1.9M to $4M) and grew the customer base by over 50%+ (45 to 70 clients), adding Enterprise customers to the SMB blend.

Innovation & Cost Efficiency: Championed and delivered two key product innovations: a patented data fragmentation technique that improved backup performance by 300% and the introduction of synthetic backups, which reduced the cost to serve by 75%.

Technical & Strategic Oversight: Served as the technical leader for the 10-engineer team (NJ, Hyderabad). Provided architectural oversight, technical guidance, and engaged with executive leadership (VP, CTO) to set long-term product strategy and roadmaps.

Team & Delivery Management: Managed distributed R&D teams, automating the delivery pipeline to ensure rapid, consistent deployment of enhancements. Accelerated engineering velocity by proactively addressing technical debt and organizational blockers.

experience.company: Goldman Sachs • Feb 2013 - Apr 2024 • New York, New York
details: Executive Leadership & Scale: Led a global engineering organization of 30+ technologists and managers across New York, Dallas, and Bangalore. Oversaw compute and personnel budgets and drove organizational structure and performance strategy.

Organizational Growth & Technical Strategy: Organically scaled a 4-person pod (2019) into a large, multi-disciplinary engineering function, directing strategy across the stack, and assuming responsibility for Data Modeling, Cloud Infrastructure, and Observability.

Governance & Risk Management: Provided executive technical governance and architectural direction from ideation through continuous delivery. Established rigorous SDLC and SRE protocols, maintaining ownership of Technology Risk, Regulatory Compliance, and Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery planning.

Critical Platform Ownership: Held functional ownership for enterprise data platforms, leading the technical design and delivery of Loan & Collateral Data Management systems and high-volume ETL pipelines that process sensitive financial data.

Business Alignment & Stakeholder Management: Managed diverse stakeholders - Trading Desks, Asset Managers, Operations, Controllers - defining roadmaps, managing budgets, and aligning engineering priorities with commercial and regulatory needs.

Data Integrity & Risk Mitigation: Drove operational resilience and compliance by delivering high-impact solutions, including data exception and review platforms. These systems prevented potential regulatory fines and mitigated operational risk while ensuring the accuracy and integrity of data for critical regulatory reporting, such as FRY-14, under strict fed timelines.

Technology & Vendor Integration: Led technical evaluation and successful onboarding of major NoSQL and NewSQL databases (MongoDB, SingleStore). Managed relationships across internal Data Infrastructure teams and external contingent worker vendors.
